bio: Aisha has chaired committees at four conferences and now trains the next generation of delegates.
name: Aisha Menon

bio: Farah has taken two climate ventures from a sketch to field deployment across South Asia and now works on impact measurement standards for early-stage climate funds.
name: Farah Khan

bio: Rohan has prepared more than two hundred students for competitive public speaking and has hosted a weekly student talk series for nine years.
name: Rohan Shah

bio: Karthik has maintained two widely used open source libraries for more than six years and has mentored over two hundred first-time contributors. He cares far more about clear communication than clever code.
name: Karthik Iyer

bio: Meera has led design sprints for early-stage teams and one national bank. She teaches the compressed prototyping method used by her studio on every engagement.
name: Meera Nair

bio: Ananya leads applied research on human-AI collaboration at Meridian Labs, where her team studies how knowledge work actually changes when AI enters the workflow. She has advised three governments on AI policy and previously built ranking systems used by two million students.
name: Dr. Ananya Rao
